checkpoints.name: City Center Terminal
checkpoints.description: Starting point for your mountain adventure. Here you can find local transportation and gather supplies.
checkpoints.notes: Best time to start: 6:00 AM. Bring water and snacks.

checkpoints.name: Mountain Base Station
checkpoints.description: Base camp for mountain expeditions. Rest area with facilities and equipment rental.
checkpoints.notes: Last chance to rent equipment and use restroom facilities.

checkpoints.name: Halfway Rest Point
checkpoints.description: Scenic rest area with panoramic views. Perfect spot for photos and a short break.
checkpoints.notes: Great photo opportunity. Take a 10-minute break here.

transports.name: Mountain Shuttle Bus
transports.description: Regular shuttle service from city center to mountain base

description: A scenic journey to the mountain observatory with multiple checkpoints and transportation options.

checkpoints.name: Central Plaza
checkpoints.description: Main city plaza with shopping centers and restaurants. Starting point for waterfront journey.
checkpoints.notes: Free parking available. Many dining options nearby.

checkpoints.name: Harbor View Point
checkpoints.description: Beautiful harbor view with historic lighthouse. Great for photos and relaxation.
checkpoints.notes: Historic lighthouse built in 1890. Free admission.

checkpoints.name: Seafood Market
checkpoints.description: Local seafood market with fresh catches. Try local specialties.
checkpoints.notes: Best seafood in the city. Try the grilled fish.

transports.name: Harbor Ferry
transports.description: Scenic ferry ride across the harbor

description: A relaxing journey through the waterfront area with harbor views and local seafood.

checkpoints.name: North District Station
checkpoints.description: Main transportation hub for the northern part of the city. Modern station with good facilities.
checkpoints.notes: Free WiFi available. ATM and convenience store on site.

checkpoints.name: Cultural Center
checkpoints.description: Historic cultural center with rotating exhibitions and local art displays.
checkpoints.notes: Free guided tours available at 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM.

checkpoints.name: Artist Quarter
checkpoints.description: Quaint neighborhood with local artist studios and craft shops.
checkpoints.notes: Many artists offer live demonstrations. Great for unique souvenirs.

description: A cultural journey through the art district with local artists and exhibitions.

checkpoints.name: City Center Metro Station
checkpoints.description: Main metro station in the city center. Convenient starting point with good connections.
checkpoints.notes: Metro runs every 10 minutes. Ticket machines accept cards and cash.

checkpoints.name: University District
checkpoints.description: Historic university area with beautiful architecture and student cafes.
checkpoints.notes: Student cafes offer affordable meals. Beautiful campus architecture.

checkpoints.name: Research Center
checkpoints.description: Botanical research center with educational exhibits about local flora.
checkpoints.notes: Educational tours available. Learn about local plant species.

description: An educational journey through the university district to the botanical gardens.

checkpoints.name: Old Town Square
checkpoints.description: Historic town square dating back to the 18th century. Starting point for heritage tour.
checkpoints.notes: Historic buildings with colonial architecture. Tourist information center available.

checkpoints.name: Colonial Museum
checkpoints.description: Small museum showcasing local colonial history and artifacts.
checkpoints.notes: Admission: $3. Audio guides available in multiple languages.

checkpoints.name: Heritage Houses
checkpoints.description: Row of preserved colonial houses with traditional architecture and gardens.
checkpoints.notes: Some houses are open for public viewing. Beautiful traditional gardens.

checkpoints.name: Traditional Market
checkpoints.description: Historic market area with traditional crafts and local products.
checkpoints.notes: Try local street food and traditional crafts. Bargaining is common.

description: A comprehensive walking tour through the historic heritage district.
